headline: Africa Energy Bank Launches With USD 5 Billion in Capital
summary: Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation launched the Africa Energy Bank with USD 5 billion in capital to finance energy projects across the continent.
why: New continental financial institutions focused on hydrocarbons and energy infrastructure address financing gaps resulting from global shifts away from fossil fuel lending.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: The launch of a multi-billion dollar capitalization fund supports capital availability for regional energy projects.
